# ehrtslib 0.12.0

Runtime bundle from [ErikSundvall/ehrtslib](https://github.com/ErikSundvall/ehrtslib) release `v0.12`, Apache-2.0. The page uses `validateFlatPayload`, `RMSpecificationValidator.validateInstance`, and `TemplateValidator` against `templates/thumb-pain.opt`. `validate(rm)` with one argument does not walk the composition. `InvariantEvaluator.validateInvariants` is not called unless an invariant list is supplied; this OPT has none.
